title: Perform Full Replacement of the Z-Axis Cable Carrier (without replacing air line or FFC)
summary: Replace the Z-axis cable carrier end-to-end while preserving the existing air line and FFC, then verify the carrier is seated (cross bars closed, dividers clear of the FFC, joints fully seated/uniform end-to-end) and restart the operator station.
when_to_use: Use when the Z-axis cable carrier must be fully replaced end-to-end while keeping the existing air line and FFC.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: perform LOTO, mechanical disassembly/reassembly, cable carrier inspection, and operator station restart.
safety_notes: Apply LOTO to the tipper before starting work (manual references “Operator Station Lockout/Tagout” on page 2).
access_or_tools_needed: Physical access to the tipper and operator station
3/8-in. wrench or socket (if needed to remove the nine (9) self-tapping securing the station side panel)
Marker or tape (to mark air line and FFC entry/exit points)
M3 socket-head screws (for FFC clamps) and M3 flat-head screws (for mounting both ends of the cable carrier)

access_required: Physical access to the tipper station and operator station
system_preconditions: Tipper is placed under LOTO before removing panels or disconnecting carrier components.
external_references: Manual: “Starting The Operator Station” on page 66

visual_references.description: FFC (flat-flex cable) and FFC clamps with M3 socket-head screws (used to support clamp removal/reinstall steps).
Tip (A-Axis) cable routing diagram showing cable carrier routing context (used to support routing/clearance expectations).
Installation diagram showing cable carrier cross bars/dividers placement and wire-tie/alignment concepts (used to support reassembly verification).
Side panel removal context (nine (9) self-tapping securing screws) and access to motor area (used to support panel access step).

steps.title: Apply LOTO to the tipper
steps.purpose: Ensure the tipper is safely locked out before any mechanical disassembly.
steps.instruction: Apply LOTO to the tipper using the manual’s “Operator Station Lockout/Tagout” method.
steps.expected_result: The tipper is under lockout/tagout (LOTO) and safe to service.
steps.healthy_condition: LOTO is applied before removing the station side panel or disconnecting any carrier/FFC/air-line ties.
steps.failure_condition: Work begins without LOTO, or LOTO is incomplete/unclear.

actions.label: Apply LOTO
actions.exact_action: LOTO the tipper (see "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout" on page 2).

source_evidence.quote: 1. LOTO the tipper (see "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout" on page 2).

steps.title: Remove the station side panel to access the motor (if necessary)
steps.purpose: Provide access to the Z-axis cable carrier components.
steps.instruction: If necessary, use a 3/8-in. wrench or socket to remove the nine (9) self-tapping securing the station side panel, then remove the station side panel to access the motor.
steps.expected_result: Station side panel is removed and motor area is accessible.
steps.healthy_condition: All nine (9) self-tapping securing fasteners are removed and the side panel is off without damaging surrounding wiring/hoses.
steps.failure_condition: Side panel is not fully removed (fasteners left in place) or access is blocked.

actions.label: Remove side panel fasteners
actions.exact_action: use a 3/8-in. wrench or socket to remove the nine (9) self-tapping securing the side panel then remove the station side panel to access the motor.

source_evidence.quote: 2. If necessary, use a 3/8-in. wrench or socket to remove the nine (9) self-tapping securing the side panel then remove the station side panel to access the motor.

steps.title: Mark the air line and FFC entry/exit points
steps.purpose: Preserve alignment so the air line and FFC can be reinstalled in the same positions.
steps.instruction: Mark the air line and FFC at both ends where they enter and exit the cable carrier using marker or tape.
steps.expected_result: Clear marks exist on the air line and FFC at both ends (entry/exit points).
steps.healthy_condition: Marks are visible and correspond to the entry/exit locations at both ends of the cable carrier.
steps.failure_condition: Marks are missing, ambiguous, or only applied to one end.

actions.label: Mark air line and FFC
actions.exact_action: Mark the air line and FFC at both ends where they enter and exit the cable carrier using a marker or tape.

source_evidence.quote: 3. Mark the air line and FFC at both ends where they enter and exit the cable carrier using a marker or tape.

steps.title: Document air line tie method and cut wire ties
steps.purpose: Ensure the air line is re-tied in the same routing/tie configuration.
steps.instruction: Note how the air line is tied to the cable carrier (take a picture) and cut the wire ties.
steps.expected_result: Air line tie points are documented and wire ties are cut so the carrier can be detached.
steps.healthy_condition: A picture exists showing the air line tie method; wire ties are cut without damaging the air line.
steps.failure_condition: Air line tie method is not documented or air line is damaged during tie removal.

actions.label: Take picture of air line tie
actions.exact_action: Note how the air line is tied to the cable carrier (take a picture) and cut the wire ties.

source_evidence.quote: 4. Note how the air line is tied to the cable carrier (take a picture) and cut the wire ties.

steps.title: Remove M3 screws holding FFC clamps in place (at both ends)
steps.purpose: Release the cable carrier from the FFC clamps while preserving clamp/FFC alignment.
steps.instruction: At both ends of the cable carrier, remove the M3 socket-head screws holding the FFC clamps in place. Confirm the clamps should stay in place on the FFC; if they fall off, mark the FFC.
steps.expected_result: FFC clamps are released from the cable carrier; clamps remain on the FFC or the FFC is marked if clamps fall off.
steps.healthy_condition: FFC clamps remain seated on the FFC; if not, FFC is marked to restore alignment later.
steps.failure_condition: FFC clamps fall off and FFC is not marked, risking misalignment.

actions.label: Remove FFC clamp screws
actions.exact_action: At both ends of the cable carrier, remove the M3 socket-head screws holding the FFC clamps in place.

actions.label: Confirm clamp retention / mark FFC
actions.exact_action: These clamps should stay in place on the FFC, but if they fall off, this is reason for marking the FFC.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the FFC clamps did not stay in place during removal and the FFC was not marked, stop and correct clamp alignment before proceeding.

source_evidence.quote: 5. At both ends of the cable carrier, remove the M3 socket-head screws holding the FFC clamps in place. These clamps should stay in place on the FFC, but if they fall off, this is reason for marking the FFC.

steps.title: Detach the cable carrier by removing M3 screws at both ends
steps.purpose: Remove the old cable carrier from the FFC and air line.
steps.instruction: Detach the cable carrier by removing the four M3 screws at both ends of the cable carrier.
steps.expected_result: Cable carrier is mechanically detached from both ends.
steps.healthy_condition: All four M3 screws at each end are removed and the carrier is free to open/snap off.
steps.failure_condition: Carrier remains fixed due to missed screws.

actions.label: Remove end screws
actions.exact_action: Detach the cable carrier by removing the four M3 screws at both ends of the cable carrier.

source_evidence.quote: 6. Detach the cable carrier by removing the four M3 screws at both ends of the cable carrier.

steps.title: Open cross bars and remove the old cable carrier
steps.purpose: Remove the old carrier without disturbing the air line and FFC beyond what is required.
steps.instruction: Open all the cross bars on the outside of the cable carrier, and remove it from the FFC and air line. You may have to snap one end of the cable carrier off to fully remove it.
steps.expected_result: Old cable carrier is removed from the FFC and air line.
steps.healthy_condition: Cross bars are fully opened and carrier comes free without pulling on the FFC or air line.
steps.failure_condition: Carrier cannot be removed because cross bars are not fully opened or it is still attached.

actions.label: Open cross bars
actions.exact_action: Open all the cross bars on the outside of the cable carrier

actions.label: Remove carrier
actions.exact_action: remove it from the FFC and air line. You may have to snap one end of the cable carrier off to fully remove it.

source_evidence.quote: 7. Open all the cross bars on the outside of the cable carrier, and remove it from the FFC and air line. You may have to snap one end of the cable carrier off to fully remove it.

steps.title: Position the new cable carrier with dividers against the air line
steps.purpose: Set the new carrier in the correct orientation and clearance before snapping it closed.
steps.instruction: Open all the cross bars on the new cable carrier and probably one end. Put the new cable carrier roughly in place while positioning the internal dividers all the way to one side, against the air line.
steps.expected_result: New carrier is positioned roughly in place with internal dividers positioned against the air line.
steps.healthy_condition: Dividers are positioned all the way to one side against the air line before snapping cross bars closed.
steps.failure_condition: Dividers are not positioned against the air line, increasing risk of divider pressing on the FFC.

actions.label: Open new carrier cross bars
actions.exact_action: Open all the cross bars on the new cable carrier and probably one end.

actions.label: Position dividers against air line
actions.exact_action: Put the new cable carrier roughly in place while positioning the internal dividers all the way to one side, against the air line.

source_evidence.quote: 8. Open all the cross bars on the new cable carrier and probably one end. 9. Put the new cable carrier roughly in place while positioning the internal dividers all the way to one side, against the air line.

steps.title: Snap cross bars closed ensuring dividers do not press on the FFC
steps.purpose: Lock the carrier in place while preserving FFC clearance.
steps.instruction: “Snap” all the cross bars closed, ensuring none of the dividers are pressing on the FFC; snap the end back on if necessary.
steps.expected_result: All cross bars are snapped closed and dividers are not pressing on the FFC.
steps.healthy_condition: No divider contact/pressure on the FFC is visible; carrier ends are fully snapped in place.
steps.failure_condition: Any divider is pressing on the FFC.

actions.label: Snap cross bars closed
actions.exact_action: “Snap” all the cross bars closed ensuring none of the dividers are pressing on the FFC and snap the end back on if necessary.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and re-check alignment/clearance if dividers are pressing on the FFC.

source_evidence.quote: 10. “Snap” all the cross bars closed ensuring none of the dividers are pressing on the FFC and snap the end back on if necessary.

steps.title: Mount both ends of the cable carrier with M3 flat-head screws
steps.purpose: Secure the carrier ends to the station structure.
steps.instruction: Mount both ends using four M3 flat-head screws.
steps.expected_result: Both ends are mounted with four M3 flat-head screws.
steps.healthy_condition: All specified screws are installed at both ends and the carrier is firmly secured.
steps.failure_condition: Any end is missing screws or carrier is loose.

actions.label: Install mounting screws
actions.exact_action: Mount both ends using four M3 flat-head.

source_evidence.quote: 11. Mount both ends using four M3 flat-head.

steps.title: Attach FFC clamps using M3 socket-head screws aligned to marks
steps.purpose: Restore correct FFC clamp alignment and secure the FFC to the carrier ends.
steps.instruction: Attach the FFC clamps using the M3 socket-head screws at both cable carrier ends; ensure the FFC clamps align with the marks from Step 1.
steps.expected_result: FFC clamps are secured at both ends and aligned to the previously applied marks.
steps.healthy_condition: Clamp positions match the Step 1 marks; clamps are seated and secured with M3 socket-head screws.
steps.failure_condition: Clamp alignment does not match the marks (risk of FFC misalignment).

actions.label: Install FFC clamp screws
actions.exact_action: Attach the FFC clamps using the M3 socket-head screws at both cable carrier ends; ensure the FFC clamps align with the marks from Step 1.

source_evidence.quote: 12. Attach the FFC clamps using the M3 socket-head screws at both cable carrier ends. Ensure the FFC clamps still align with the marks from Step 1.

steps.title: Wire-tie the air line in the cable carrier using marks
steps.purpose: Restore air line routing and secure it within the carrier.
steps.instruction: Position the air line in the cable carrier using the marks from Step 1 and wire tie it in place.
steps.expected_result: Air line is positioned according to Step 1 marks and secured with wire ties.
steps.healthy_condition: Air line routing matches the marks and is firmly wire-tied without slack or strain.
steps.failure_condition: Air line is mispositioned relative to marks or not secured.

actions.label: Wire-tie air line
actions.exact_action: Position the air line in the cable carrier using the marks from Step 1 and wire tie in place.

source_evidence.quote: 13. Position the air line in the cable carrier using the marks from Step 1 and wire tie in place.

steps.title: Inspect cable carrier seating, clearance, and joint uniformity
steps.purpose: Confirm the carrier is correctly installed before restarting.
steps.instruction: Inspect the cable carrier: verify all cross bars are closed, the dividers are not pressing on the FFC, and all the cable carrier joints are fully seated. The cable carrier should look very uniform end to end.
steps.expected_result: Cross bars are closed; dividers are not pressing on the FFC; joints are fully seated; carrier appears uniform end-to-end.
steps.healthy_condition: Visual inspection shows uniform end-to-end appearance with no divider pressure on the FFC and fully seated joints.
steps.failure_condition: Any cross bar is not closed, dividers press on the FFC, or joints are not fully seated (non-uniform appearance).

actions.label: Visual inspection
actions.exact_action: Inspect the cable carrier to ensure all the cross bars are closed, the dividers are not pressing on the FFC, and all the cable carrier joints are fully seated.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and re-check alignment/clearance if dividers are pressing on the FFC or if cable carrier joints do not appear fully seated/uniform end-to-end.

source_evidence.quote: 14. Inspect the cable carrier to ensure all the cross bars are closed, the dividers are not pressing on the FFC, and all the cable carrier joints are fully seated. The cable carrier will look uniform end to end.

steps.title: Reinstall top and/or bottom side panels (if necessary)
steps.instruction: Reinstall the top and/or bottom side panels, if necessary.
steps.expected_result: Top and/or bottom side panels are reinstalled as required.
steps.healthy_condition: Panels are installed and the station is re-closed without leaving access panels open.
steps.failure_condition: Panels not reinstalled when required, leaving components exposed.

actions.label: Reinstall panels
actions.exact_action: Reinstall the top and/or bottom side panels, if necessary.

source_evidence.quote: 15. Reinstall the top and/or bottom side panels, if necessary.

steps.title: Restart the operator station
steps.purpose: Bring the system back to operational state after mechanical replacement.
steps.instruction: Re-start the operator station (see “Starting The Operator Station” on page 66).
steps.healthy_condition: Operator station restart completes without failure and system proceeds to normal operation.
steps.failure_condition: Operator station does not restart after reassembly.

actions.label: Restart operator station
actions.exact_action: Re-start the operator station (see "Starting The Operator Station" on page 66).

stop_or_escalate_if: If the operator station does not restart after reassembly, escalate to the appropriate support process (manual references “Starting The Operator Station” on page 66).

source_evidence.quote: 16. Re-start the operator station (see "Starting The Operator Station" on page 66).

success_criteria: New Z-axis cable carrier installed with all cross bars closed.
Dividers are not pressing on the FFC.
Cable carrier joints are fully seated and carrier looks uniform end to end.
healthy_conditions: Dividers are not pressing on the FFC.
Cable carrier joints are fully seated; uniform end-to-end appearance.
failure_conditions: Cable carrier joints not fully seated or non-uniform end-to-end appearance.
FFC clamps misaligned (not aligned to Step 1 marks).
Operator station does not restart after reassembly.
escalation_guidance: If the operator station does not restart after reassembly, escalate to the appropriate support process referenced by the manual’s “Starting The Operator Station” on page 66.
missing_details: The manual section provided references “Starting The Operator Station” on page 66, but the specific restart control/sequence is not included in the provided source text; operator must follow the referenced page for the exact restart actions.
